d:
Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has challenged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to participate in an open debate on key issues concerning the country. Extending an invitation to the Prime Minister, Rahul Gandhi said, ‘Come forward, don't be afraid,’ questioning the government's willingness to face public scrutiny. The proposed debate could cover important political, economic and national issues, including the government's performance and its policies. What exactly did Rahul Gandhi say, why has he challenged PM Modi, and how has the BJP responded?
